subtasks.title: Test and optimize accessibility of FAQ section

tasks.title: Implement Visual Enhancements
tasks.description: Create and integrate new visual elements including integration workflow diagrams, before/after comparisons, system connection visuals, and badges.
tasks.details:

2. Test image loading performance
3. Validate responsive behavior of visuals on various screen sizes
4. Check alt text for all new images
5. Verify color consistency with brand guidelines
6. Test dark mode compatibility if applicable
7. Verify accessibility of visual elements

subtasks.title: Design and Create Integration Workflow Diagrams
subtasks.description: Design and develop visual diagrams that illustrate the integration workflow process for the process section of the website.
subtasks.details: Create SVG-based workflow diagrams showing how different systems integrate. Use the brand color palette with purple accent (#6E00FF) for highlights. Include clear step indicators and connection lines between components. Design at least 3 different workflow diagrams: 1) Website to Ad Platform integration, 2) Data flow between systems, and 3) Customer journey through integrated touchpoints. Ensure diagrams are responsive by using viewBox attributes and relative sizing. Save files in both SVG and optimized PNG formats.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify diagrams render correctly across browsers. Test SVG scaling on different screen sizes. Validate that the diagrams effectively communicate the integration workflow. Ensure file sizes are optimized (<100KB for PNG versions).

subtasks.title: Develop Before/After Comparison Visuals
subtasks.description: Create interactive before/after comparison visuals for each industry section (Construction, Real Estate, Auto Detailing) to demonstrate the impact of integrated systems.
subtasks.details: Design comparison sliders that show 'Before Integration' and 'After Integration' states for each industry. Use actual metrics and data points in the visuals (e.g., 40% increase in qualified leads). Implement using CSS and minimal JavaScript for the slider functionality. Each comparison should include: branded visual elements, key metrics highlighted with the accent color (#6E00FF), and clear labels. Create one comparison visual per industry (3 total). Optimize images to under 150KB each.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test slider functionality across devices. Verify smooth transitions between before/after states. Ensure responsive behavior works on mobile devices. Validate that metrics are clearly visible at all viewport sizes.

subtasks.title: Create System Connection Visuals
subtasks.description: Develop visual representations showing how different components of the integrated system work together for maximum effectiveness.
subtasks.details: Design node-based connection diagrams showing the relationship between website, ads, CRM, and other system components. Use consistent iconography for each system component. Create connection lines with directional indicators showing data flow. Include small tooltips or labels explaining each connection's purpose. Design in a modular way that allows for responsive rearrangement on smaller screens. Create at least one master system connection visual and 3 simplified versions for different sections of the site. Use SVG format for scalability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test visibility of connection lines and labels at different screen sizes. Verify that the visual hierarchy effectively communicates system relationships. Ensure all icons and components maintain proper spacing when scaled. Check that tooltips/labels are accessible and readable.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement 'INTEGRATED SYSTEM' Badges
subtasks.description: Create distinctive badges with the purple accent color (#6E00FF) to highlight integrated system features throughout the website.
subtasks.details: Design badge templates in SVG format with the text 'INTEGRATED SYSTEM' prominently displayed. Use the purple accent color (#6E00FF) as the primary color with appropriate contrast for text readability. Create variations: standard badge, corner ribbon badge, and inline badge. Implement badges as reusable components that can be easily added to different sections. Include subtle animation on hover (scale or glow effect). Ensure badges are accessible with appropriate contrast ratios. Create both light and dark mode versions if the site supports dark mode.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test badge rendering across browsers. Verify hover animations work consistently. Check contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards. Ensure badges scale appropriately on different devices without pixelation. Validate that badges are visually consistent with the overall brand.

subtasks.title: Integrate and Optimize All Visual Elements
subtasks.description: Implement all created visual elements into their respective sections with proper responsiveness, accessibility, and performance optimization.
subtasks.details: Integrate all visual assets into the appropriate website sections. Implement responsive behavior using CSS media queries to adjust visual presentation across device sizes. Add appropriate alt text to all images following accessibility best practices. Implement lazy loading for all images to improve performance. Compress and optimize all image assets (target <100KB for most images). Ensure consistent styling and spacing around visuals. Add appropriate fade-in animations when visuals enter the viewport. Test and verify that all visuals maintain brand consistency across the site. Document the location and purpose of each visual element for future reference.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test page load performance before and after integration. Verify all images have appropriate alt text. Test responsive behavior across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports. Validate that lazy loading works correctly. Check that all animations perform smoothly. Verify visual consistency across different sections of the site.

subtasks.testStrategy: Test FAQ interactions to verify events fire correctly, validate content engagement metrics by scrolling through content at different speeds, check video tracking by playing/pausing videos, and verify heatmap data collection.

subtasks.title: Test, validate and document analytics implementation
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of all tracking implementations, validate data accuracy, create documentation, and ensure privacy compliance across all tracking mechanisms.

2. Verify all tracking events fire correctly across browsers and devices

4. Validate custom events are properly configured and capturing intended data
5. Check that conversion tracking works for all form submissions

tasks.title: Optimize Mobile Responsiveness
tasks.description: Ensure all new and updated sections are fully responsive with optimized layouts, typography, and interactions for mobile devices.

subtasks.title: Implement Responsive Grid Layouts
subtasks.description: Create and implement responsive grid layouts for all new sections that adapt to different screen sizes, with a focus on mobile-first design.
subtasks.details:
1. Review all new sections from previous tasks (Integration Benefits, Pricing, Industry, FAQ)
2. Implement CSS Grid or Flexbox layouts for each section
3. Set up appropriate container widths with max-width properties
4. Define column structures that collapse appropriately on smaller screens
5. Ensure consistent margins and padding across breakpoints
6. Implement proper nesting of grid elements for complex layouts
subtasks.testStrategy: Test layouts on various screen widths (320px, 375px, 414px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px) to ensure content flows correctly without horizontal scrolling or overflow issues.

subtasks.title: Optimize Typography and Touch Interactions
subtasks.description: Adjust typography for readability on mobile devices and ensure all interactive elements are touch-friendly with appropriate sizing and spacing.
subtasks.details:
1. Increase base font size for mobile (minimum 16px)
2. Adjust heading sizes using a responsive type scale
3. Ensure line heights are optimized for mobile reading (1.4-1.6)
4. Make all interactive elements (buttons, links, accordions) at least 44px × 44px for touch targets
5. Add appropriate hover/active states for touch interactions
6. Ensure sufficient spacing between clickable elements to prevent accidental taps
7. Optimize form input fields for touch interaction
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with actual mobile devices to verify text readability at arm's length. Verify all interactive elements can be easily tapped without zooming or precision targeting.

subtasks.title: Implement Mobile-Optimized Images and Media
subtasks.description: Optimize all images and media for mobile devices to improve loading times and visual presentation on smaller screens.
subtasks.details:
1. Implement responsive images using srcset and sizes attributes
2. Create and serve appropriately sized image variants for different viewports
3. Use modern image formats (WebP with fallbacks)
4. Implement lazy loading for images below the fold
5. Adjust image aspect ratios where needed for mobile displays
6. Ensure proper image compression for faster loading on mobile connections
7. Consider implementing a content delivery network (CDN) for media assets
subtasks.testStrategy: Test image loading times on simulated 3G and 4G connections. Verify images appear crisp without excessive data usage or layout shifts during loading.

subtasks.title: Configure Responsive Breakpoints and Spacing
subtasks.description: Establish appropriate breakpoints for different device sizes and adjust spacing, padding, and margins for optimal mobile display.
subtasks.details:
1. Define standard breakpoints at common device widths (e.g., 576px, 768px, 992px, 1200px)
2. Implement media queries for each breakpoint in a consistent manner
3. Reduce padding and margins proportionally for smaller screens
4. Adjust component spacing to maintain visual hierarchy on mobile
5. Ensure proper stacking order of elements when layouts shift to single column
6. Implement consistent spacing variables/tokens across the site
7. Test and refine spacing between sections for optimal mobile scrolling experience
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the site at each breakpoint to ensure smooth transitions between layouts. Verify spacing is appropriate at all screen sizes with no excessive whitespace or cramped content.

subtasks.title: Test and Optimize Mobile Performance
subtasks.description: Conduct comprehensive testing of mobile responsiveness and performance, making final optimizations to ensure a smooth user experience across all devices.
subtasks.details:
1. Run Lighthouse mobile performance audits and address issues
2. Test loading performance on simulated slow connections
3. Verify all CTAs are easily accessible on mobile without scrolling issues
4. Test form submissions and interactive elements on actual mobile devices
5. Ensure navigation elements are accessible and usable on small screens
6. Check for and eliminate any horizontal scrolling issues
7. Verify touch gestures work as expected (swipes, taps, etc.)
8. Test with different mobile browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
9. Implement any final adjustments based on testing results
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct user testing on various physical devices. Use Chrome DevTools to simulate different devices and network conditions. Run Lighthouse performance audits targeting mobile and implement recommendations to achieve scores of 90+ in all categories.

tasks.title: Conduct Quality Assurance Testing
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of all updated sections to ensure functionality, performance, and accessibility standards are maintained.
tasks.details:
1. Test all updated sections for visual consistency
2. Verify all links and CTAs function correctly
3. Test form submissions and validation
4. Check analytics tracking for all events
5. Validate responsive behavior across devices
6. Perform accessibility testing with screen readers
7. Test keyboard navigation throughout the page
8. Verify performance meets or exceeds current standards
9. Check for any console errors or warnings
10. Test with various browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
11. Verify all animations and transitions work correctly
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create a comprehensive test plan covering all sections
2. Use browser developer tools to test responsive layouts
3. Employ accessibility testing tools (WAVE, axe)
4. Test with actual screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver)
5. Use Lighthouse for performance testing
6. Conduct cross-browser testing
7. Test on actual mobile devices
8. Verify analytics in test environment

subtasks.title: Create Comprehensive Test Plan and Conduct Visual/Functional Testing
subtasks.description: Develop a detailed test plan covering all updated sections and perform visual consistency and functional testing of links, CTAs, and form submissions.
subtasks.details:
1. Create a spreadsheet with all updated sections to be tested
2. Test each section for visual consistency with design specifications
3. Verify all links direct to correct destinations
4. Test all CTAs for proper functionality and tracking
5. Test all form submissions with valid and invalid data
6. Verify form validation messages appear correctly
7. Document any visual or functional issues found
subtasks.testStrategy: Use a combination of manual testing and automated tools like Cypress for functional testing. Create test cases for each form field with valid/invalid inputs. Take screenshots for visual comparison.

subtasks.title: Perform Responsive and Cross-Browser Testing
subtasks.description: Test the website's responsive behavior across different devices and verify compatibility with various browsers.
subtasks.details:
1. Test responsive layouts at standard breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px)
2. Verify all elements adjust appropriately at each breakpoint
3. Test on physical devices when possible (iPhone, Android, tablet)
4. Test with Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers
5. Verify all animations and transitions work correctly across browsers
6. Check for any browser-specific console errors or warnings
7. Document any responsive or cross-browser issues
subtasks.testStrategy: Use browser developer tools to test responsive layouts. Employ BrowserStack or similar tools for cross-browser testing. Create a matrix of devices/browsers to ensure comprehensive coverage.

subtasks.title: Conduct Accessibility Testing
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive accessibility testing to ensure the website meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
subtasks.details:
1. Run automated accessibility scans using WAVE and axe tools
2. Test keyboard navigation throughout all interactive elements
3. Verify proper focus states are visible for all interactive elements
4. Test with screen readers (NVDA on Windows, VoiceOver on Mac)
5. Check color contrast ratios for all text elements
6. Verify all images have appropriate alt text
7. Test form accessibility including labels and error messages
8. Document all accessibility issues found
subtasks.testStrategy: Use a combination of automated tools (WAVE, axe) and manual testing with keyboard navigation and screen readers. Create a checklist based on WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.

subtasks.title: Perform Performance and Analytics Testing
subtasks.description: Test website performance metrics and verify that all analytics tracking is implemented correctly.
subtasks.details:
1. Run Lighthouse performance audits on all key pages
2. Verify Core Web Vitals meet or exceed current standards
3. Check for render-blocking resources and optimize if needed
4. Verify image optimization across the site
5. Test analytics tracking for all events and conversions
6. Confirm that all user interactions are properly tracked
7. Verify that custom events are firing correctly
8. Document performance metrics and any analytics issues
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Lighthouse for performance testing and set minimum score thresholds. Use browser developer tools to verify analytics events are firing correctly. Create test scenarios for each tracked event.

subtasks.title: Compile Test Results and Prepare Final QA Report
subtasks.description: Consolidate all test results, document issues found, and prepare a comprehensive QA report with recommendations for fixes.
subtasks.details:
1. Compile all issues found during testing into a centralized document
2. Categorize issues by severity (critical, high, medium, low)
3. Include screenshots and steps to reproduce for each issue
4. Prioritize issues that must be fixed before deployment
5. Create JIRA tickets or equivalent for each issue
6. Prepare executive summary of testing results
7. Make recommendations for fixes and improvements
8. Develop a verification plan for retesting fixed issues
subtasks.testStrategy: Use a standardized template for the QA report. Include metrics on test coverage and issue severity distribution. Provide clear acceptance criteria for each reported issue.

7. Analyze heatmaps of user interactions if available
8. Compare all metrics to pre-update baseline
9. Identify any significant changes in user behavior
10. Document initial findings for optimization opportunities

subtasks.title: Prepare Performance Report and Implement Adjustments
subtasks.description: Compile comprehensive performance data, prepare an initial performance report, and implement necessary adjustments based on the findings.
subtasks.details:
1. Collect and analyze all performance data after 1 week
2. Compare key metrics to pre-deployment baseline
3. Identify any underperforming areas or unexpected behaviors
4. Prepare a detailed report with visualizations of key metrics
5. Develop recommendations for immediate optimizations
6. Implement critical adjustments based on data findings
7. A/B test potential solutions for underperforming elements
8. Document all changes made post-launch
9. Update stakeholders on performance and adjustments
10. Establish ongoing monitoring and optimization schedule
subtasks.testStrategy:
1. Validate that implemented adjustments resolve identified issues
2. Test any new changes across browsers and devices
3. Verify that adjustments don't negatively impact other metrics
4. Monitor performance changes after adjustments
5. Validate data accuracy in performance reports
